title: Chelum Kare Jawaan Ali Akber ke Matami
body:
Likhenge daastaan Ali akber ke matami
Jayeinge do jahaan Ali akber ke matami
Hotey hai jaweedaan Ali akber ke matami
Chelum kare jawaan Ali akber ke matami
1. Peeri chali jawan Ali akber ke wastey
Aye kash hum bhi hotey wa purse ke waste
Aajatey darmiyaan sabhi...(2)
Aajatey darmiya Ali akber ke matami
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shadi ke sin mey mout jo akber ko aagayi
Qabr e pisar pa rooti hai madar khadi
Huwi karte hai ab fugaan sabhi..(2)
Karte hai ab fugaan Ali akber ke matami
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Akber k khoon se ho gaya maidan lahoo lahoo
Maa baap ke sabhi huwe Armaan lahoo lahoo
Mazloom baap maa huwe..(2)
Mazloom baap maa Ali akber ke matami
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Amma tumhari qabr per roone ko rehgayi
Akber tumhare soog mey roye jawaan sabhi
Wareinge apni jaan sabhi...(2)
Wareinge apni jaan Ali akber ke matami
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sarwar bhi aaj rotey hai matam me aanker
Seene pa haat maar ke dawar bayaan kar
Zinda rahe jawan sabhi..(2)
Zinda rahe jawan Ali akber ke matami
Azz...dawar Ali dawar
